name: interactive-xapi-designer
description: Build accessible SLS interactives in one pass with verified scoring, misconception analytics, and visual teacher reports.

interface.shortDescription: Build verified SLS interactives in one pass.
interface.longDescription: Turns a learning goal or existing interactive into an accessible SLS-ready package in one pass, with verified scoring, item evidence, misconceptions, revisions, privacy-safe process data, visual teacher feedback, completion fallback capture, and mock-LRS transport checks.
defaultPrompt: Build an SLS interactive in one pass with verified xAPI scoring and a visual teacher report.
Turn this lesson idea into an accessible virtual lab.
Improve this ZIP for SLS and make the teacher analytics useful.
